data.heading: 1. Rabi Season harvest and Summer Season Sowing Status:
data.text:
As on March 27, 2026, the area sown under summer crops is 49.87 lakh ha as compared to 52.35 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.  Of this, area of 28.50 lakh ha has been sown under Rice this year.
-  As on 27.03.2026, 32.26% of area has been harvested for Rabi crops all over India. Approximately 67% area of Pulses mainly in Gram (66%), Urdbean (86%) & Moong (63%); 71.56% area of Oilseeds majorly in  Rapeseed  & Mustard (75.53%); 38.31% area of Shri Anna cum Coarse Cereals majorly in Jowar (54.47%), 25.57% area of Rice and 6.00% area of Wheat  has been harvested for Rabi crops 2025-26.

data.heading: Week 1 (27 March - 02 April 2026):
data.text: -  Maximum Temperature is likely to be above normal over many parts of North West India, East India, Chhattisgarh, Konkan & Goa, Coastal Karnataka, North Kerala, Coastal Andhra Pradesh & Yanam and coastal regions of Tamil Nadu.

data.heading: Week 2 (03 April - 09 April 2026):
data.text:
-  Maximum  temperature  is  likely  to  be  above  normal  over  many  parts  of  North  West  India,  East India, South India, Chhattisgarh and Konkan & Goa.
-  No Heat Wave conditions likely during the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice: About 28.50 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 30.69 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses: About  6.06  lakh  ha  area  coverage  has  been  reported  compared  to  5.60  lakh  ha  during  the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds: About 5.97 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 6.34 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
